methods.label: Master Catalogue mixed-script compound method

inputPolicy.angel: Use the declared Hebrew spelling and Mispar Hechrachi value supplied by the catalogue.
inputPolicy.daemon: Use the declared Latin/English spelling and English Ordinal value.
inputPolicy.compound: Add angel Hebrew value to daemon English Ordinal value.
inputPolicy.reduction: Apply digit reduction to the compound as declared by the catalogue.

caveats: Mixed-script arithmetic is a project method, not evidence that two names are historically or metaphysically identical.
Changing Hebrew spelling, transliteration, or daemon spelling changes results.

methods.label: Solomonic Pairing shared Latin-script four-cipher method
methods.scope: Pairwise and Reunited Name comparison on a common Latin-script footing

inputPolicy.normalization: Preserve the declared Latin spelling/transliteration; uppercase A–Z for cipher evaluation unless the source method says otherwise.
inputPolicy.ciphers: English Ordinal (EO), Full Reduction (FR), Reverse Ordinal (RO), Reverse Full Reduction (RFR).
inputPolicy.reunitedClassification: RESOLVE = exact equality in at least one full cipher; BRIDGE = length-normalized profile between both sources on at least 3 of 4 axes; TRANSCEND = otherwise an emergent third profile.

caveats: RESOLVE / BRIDGE / TRANSCEND are computational and interpretive labels, not metaphysical validation.
A different spelling or transliteration requires recalculation rather than retrofitting the prior result.
